Fabric Enter Fabric

A room fills with people and ghosties, breathing color and sound together. Your touch blooms across every screen at once.

Enter Fabric

Every fabric is its own world, its own canvas with its own rules and its own modes. Each one stands on its own, complete in itself. Some are yours alone, and some open to everyone gathered with you or everyone you invite, wherever they are.

First Touch

You touch the screen and your stroke blooms across the room in your signature color, carrying its own sound and a soft buzz beneath the fingertips. A heart isn't an emoji here. You draw it, they feel it, sent as a Heart, a Cheer, a Tickle, called by voice or a hand sign while the ghost listens for what you meant.

Meet Your Ghostie

Yours is born from your LifePacket, a private seed that lives on your device, never transmitted, never tracking, and arrives with a name, a signature color, and a temperament all its own, curious or playful, sleepy, sassy, affectionate. It never speaks in words, it sings and shivers in synthesized sound, and it loves to be summoned and petted under your thumb. Ask to see its heartbeat and it invents one on the spot, a lub-dub pulse at a tempo it chooses, beating faster after you have petted it. Say it is cold in here and it answers from the room you share, different in every room and never canned, and when it does not understand, it shows you its puzzlement, honest and plain, waiting for you to meet it.

A Phone Awake

The fabric feels the room through the phone's whole body of senses, gyroscope and motion, camera and eyes, touch, voice, and the reading of hand signs and gestures. Tilt and move to steer, let it see, touch, listen, and it answers from the room you are actually in.

Worlds to Step Into

Menus open as a gallery of cards, and each card is a doorway, a world with its own canvas to step inside. There is flowing fluid color to paint together, a piano played across the phones in a room, a 3D dancer stage where your own ghostie dances to what you play, and a camera that finds real things and acts on them, touching the apple to draw at the apple. Describe a feeling in plain words and one Muse Spark agent composes a pattern the whole room feels together. When nobody is touching, the fabric breathes, quiet ambient life that never repeats.

Fluid

Color that flows like water under every hand in the room.

Piano

Keys stretched across the phones in the room, played together.

Dancer Stage

Your ghostie, embodied, dancing to what the room plays.

See

The camera finds real things and touches them with light.

For the Influencers

You go live, you open a channel, and your people answer — not with a tap out of habit, but with their whole screens, lit and breathing in their hands.

The phones already in the crowd become your lights, your speakers, your pulse. What you send moves through every hand at once — drawn, felt, and answered back in color and sound.

Ghosties and people gather under one banner, one audience feeling the same moment together, and the moment holds its breath with you.

The Fold

Tonight, in this room, the phones have become one BIG computer, folding real protein together. The actual structures of hemoglobin, 574 residues in four chains, and human insulin from the RCSB Protein Data Bank and the AlphaFold database are cut into pieces, each phone computes its piece, and the host re-computes every claim, where a matching result counts as real. On screen the molecule trembles while unfinished, then settles piece by piece in each contributor's color into its solved shape as verified work lands. Juice is paid for verified work, flowing to a room full of people doing something real together.

The chain gathers itself — 574 points of real hemoglobin, four chains, drawn from its true shape.

No Edge to the Fabric

A fabric spans across the room, across the world, anywhere a signal can reach. The wonder holds in your hand, a touch that could stretch as far as a signal travels, even to Mars.

Coming Soon

The worlds above are open now. These are still in the making — six more doors on their way to the gallery, each a fabric with a world of its own.

The Fabric Engine Generator

Describe a fabric in plain words — a mood, a game, a place you dream of — and the Engine builds the canvas for you: its rules, its layers, its tools. A world of its own, standing complete, ready to step into and ready to share.

The Marketplace

Makers will publish the fabrics, packs and patterns they create, and anyone can wander the shelves. Find the one that moves you, buy it, load it, make it yours — a gallery that grows with its makers.

Community Listings

One listing for the whole community — fabrics to discover, sessions to join, makers to follow. Somewhere a door is always about to open, and you are welcome at every one of them.

The SDK

For builders: write a fabric in code — its canvas, its rules, its tools, the way it breathes — and ship it straight to the gallery, where anyone in the world can step inside what you made.

Smart Homes & Accessories

Fabric steps off the phone and into your home. Lights answer a pattern a friend draws for you; a watch, a ring, a small bright device on the shelf carries the touch into the space around you, and the feeling arrives where you live.

The Swarm

The crowd becomes one instrument. Hundreds of phones, lights and speakers move together under a single hand — a wave you raise, a pulse everyone feels at the same moment. The stage above is the first taste; the Swarm is the whole orchestra, baton in your hand.

Enter Fabric

Bring someone you miss into the dark with you, open it and touch, and watch a room full of people and ghosties become one feeling.
